items.label: ALL-IN-ONE OFFICE DESK
items.value: Coming with a storage cabinet, file drawer, and storage shelves, this executive desk create a versatile workstation that’ll meet all your needs. File cabinet can hold letter/A4 files, keeping your important documents organized and easy to find, while the small drawer and open shelves are sufficient for any other office supplies. This L shaped desk is economic to meet different storage needs.

items.label: LARGE WORKING SPACE
items.value: This larger office desk offers a spacious work area with a 63” L large desktop and 31.5" W width that can accommodate multiple monitors and laptops as well as any necessary work supplies. Moreover, with a height of 29.5" and ample legroom, you can comfortably stretch your legs while working, gaming, writing, or engaging in any other home office activities.

items.label: SOLID CONSTRUCTION
items.value: This solid constructed computer desk is made from high quality board and rugged metal frame, which is sturdy enough to support an all-in-one computer, while the scratch- resistant laminate finish protects the desk's surface from daily wear and tear, ensuring durable enough for long time use.

items.label: MODERN L SHAPED DESK
items.value: With the combination of functional design and elegant grid design, this l shaped executive desk not only includes practical performance of modern furniture, but also adds a nice addition to your room. The decent and elegant appearance makes this office desk and filing cabinet look great in your space as a workstation.

items.label: BUY WITH CONFIDENCE
items.value: Coming with quite clear instructions, numbered parts and all necessary tools, this computer desk with drawers could be easily assembled. Please Note that the desk and cabinet will be shipped with two separage parcels.
